generalities.text: Main THE ENCYCLOPEDIA OF PURE MATERIA MEDICA By TIMOTHY F. ALLEN, A.M., M.D. Presented by Médi-T CUPRUM SULFURICUM. Sulphate of Copper, CuSO 4 5H 2 O; Blue vitriol; Cuprum vitriolatum. Preparation , Solution in water. Authorities. A , Hahnemann, from Fragmenta de viribus. 1 , Greding udov, Adv., I, 535, effects of grain doses in epileptics, from Hahnemann's Cuprum in Chr. Kn.; 2 , Kinglake, Lond. Med. Phys. Journ., V, 438, from Cup. sulf., given for epilepsy, from Hahnemann; 3 , Simmons, Med. and Phil. Comm., IV, 33, from touching wound in hand with cup. sulf., from Hahnemann; 4 , Journ. de Chim. Méd., 3, 639, a man took 10 grains in by water, from Wibmer; 5 , Rust's Mag., 1824, a workman swallowed some by mistake (Frank's Mag., 1, 465); 6 , Willich, Baldinger neues Mag., 1785, a woman was poisoned by blue vitriol becoming mixed with pepper in a mortar; 7 , Moschka, translated in Hahn. Hacking cough which impedes respiration. Croupy cough with very tenacious mucus. Limbs cold, nearly cyanotic. Dull aching soreness in middle of tibia, when walking; > at rest; tenderness on pressure.

Restless, throws himself about in bed. Restlessness at night ; twitchings ; trembling in the limbs ; copious stools. Frequent subsultus tendinum. Lassitude, debility. Lasting five minutes ; palpitation ; pricking in feet and legs. Lasting thirty minutes : heat of feet and legs. Three successive times : profuse catamenia, induced by bathing feet in solution. Rapidly following each other : stages of fever. Frequent : subsultus tendinum. At short intervals : shooting in temples. From time to time : vomiting. Chronic : diarrhœa. Left : shooting in temple. Left to right : coldness in legs ; heat on feet and shins. Right : bald spot on parietal bone. Inward : shooting in temples. As of a tight narrow band round head ; as if top of head would come off ; as of going to sleep in vertex ; as if paralyzed, tongue ; as if burnt, throat ; as if bruised, hypochondria ; as of a throbbing lump in heart ; as if needles were pricking on feet and legs. Pain : violent in forehead ; violent in stomach ; in epigastrium ; in abdomen ; in back. Tearing : in hypochondria ; behind sternum. Shooting : in temples. Cutting : in bowels. Pricking : as of needles on feet and legs. Burning : in mouth and œsophagus ; in stomach ; in bowels ; of soles. Dull aching : in tibia. Pressure : in pit of stomach ; in chest. Pressing down : in vertex. Soreness : in tibia. Tensive pain : at root of nose ; in mouth ; in pharynx ; in stomach. Contraction : in pharynx ; of chest. Choking : in pharynx. Twitching : of closed lids. Throbbing : in head. Roaring : in head. Dull sensation : in vertex. Uneasiness : between shoulders. Formication : in legs. Crawling : in vertex. (OBS :) Destroys flabby granulations and exerts a powerful excitant influence ; its solution acts more feebly, and is sometimes employed as a dressing for indolent ulcers. (OBS :) Fifty patients, who showed various manifestations of syphilis, were cured by the copper sulphate ; the copper salt proved more efficacious and required less time for its beneficial action than did the mercury salts ; in a case of very grave syphilis, where mercury had proved useless, copper effected a rapid and complete cure. keynotes.text: Sulphate of Copper is a well-known emetic and caustic. It causes forcible vomiting and much nausea. Paleness of face; or jaundiced appearance; pale skin generally; a peculiar diarrhœa; enlarged liver. J. D. Tyrrell (Med. Adv., xix. 14) mentions the case of a lady who could not use Cupr. sul. for "stamping" fancywork, because it "made her face hurt and swell so she could scarcely see, and her lips became everted, "turned inside out," she said." It is a well-known application in allopathic practice for stimulating flabby granulations, and it has cured itching eruptions, and manifestations of syphilis. Rest > pains.

mental_emotional.text: Anxiety; or great apathy. Remarkable disturbance of mind, every utterance distorted.
Anxiety, or great apathy. Remarkable disturbance of mind ; every utterance distorted. All senses vanish. Vertigo, with prostration of strength, and dim sight.

head.text: Bald spot over r. parietal bone, not depending on any discoverable cause.

Violent pain in forehead, with severe tensive pain at root of nose. After rising from bed, pain like a tight, narrow band all round head (on a level with upper part of forehead) and feeling as if top of head would come off ; < laughing or stooping ; > by cold wind ; desire to be quiet. Shooting inwards in temples at short intervals, the left being first affected, > by pressing temples with hands ; irritability of temper. Crawling, dull sensation in vertex, as if going to sleep, with a pressing-down sensation, and stupefaction. Throbbing and roaring in head. Severe headache, in morning. Bald spot over right parietal bone, not depending upon any discoverable cause.

eyes.text: Twitching of closed lids. Eyes stiff and dim.
Eyes stiff and dim. Eyes moving to and fro. Icteric color of conjunctivæ. Twitching of closed lids. (OBS :) Trachoma ; granular lids ; catarrhal and purulent conjunctivitis.

face.text: Lips pale, bluish, at corners and internal edges. Face painful and swollen so she can scarcely see; lips turned inside out.
(OBS :) Face pale : emaciated, eyes sunken ; puffy, red, covered with great drops of sweat. Lips pale, bluish, at corners and internal edges.

mouth_throat.text: Tongue cold; coated, bluish. Greenish tint along free border of gums. Burning in mouth and œsophagus in morning.

Greenish tint along free borders of gums. Taste : sweetish ; bitter ; coppery ; metallic on waking. Tongue : white furred ; coated, bluish, cold ; swollen, stiff, as if paralyzed. Tongue small, white, rough. Burning in mouth and œsophagus in morning. Sharp biting heat in mouth and throat. Ulcer in the mouth, after fever. Tensive pain in mouth, pharynx, root of nose, and stomach. Choking and contracting sensation in pharynx. Throat painful and as if burnt.

stomach_abdomen.text: Excessive nausea; forcible vomiting returning from time to time; vomits greenish-brown mucus. Violent pain in stomach followed by faintness. Tearing pains in hypochondria, on inspiration, painful to touch as if bruised. Liver enlarged. Abdomen drawn in.

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cupr. s.]. Loss of appetite. Great thirst ; want of thirst with sweat. Thirst with sweat and oppression of chest. Hiccough. Excessive nausea ; qualmish nausea. Vomiting forcible, returning from time to time. Vomiting : of greenish-brown mucus ; of a bluish matter. Nausea ; vomiting < after 5 A. M. Pressure in pit of stomach. Distension and fulness of stomach rather than pain. Burning in stomach. Violent pain in stomach followed by faintness. Tearing pains in hypochondria, on inspiration, painful on touch as if bruised. Liver enlarged. Pain in epigastrium, sensitive to pressure. Abdomen swollen, tender, and painful ; flat and painful ; drawn in. Constant cutting, burning pain in bowels. Enteritis.

stool_rectum.text: Four pultaceous greenish-yellow stools, without the least trace of blood. Stool pultaceous, brown-red, with streaks of blood and tenesmus during stool. Constipation.

Urging to stool. Four pultaceous, greenish-yellow stools. Vomiting, soon followed by paleness and cold sweat ; severe efforts at stool, alternating with vomiting, frequent attacks of unconsciousness, copious stools. Diarrhœa of children. (OBS :) Chronic diarrhœa with ulceration.

chest_heart.text: Feeling as of a throbbing lump in heart internally, beating of heart seems louder; lasted five minutes and went away gradually.

Anxiety and oppression in chest. Pressive pain in chest. Painful contraction of chest, < after drinking. Tearing pains behind sternum, extending over several parts of chest. Hæmoptysis. Feeling as of a throbbing lump in heart internally, beating of heart seemed louder ; lasted five minutes, and went away gradually. Sounds of heart weak and limited ; slight friction-sound at base. Pulse : small, soft, or hard ; quick and small ; full and hard.

skin.text: Pale, colourless. Icterus. Itching nodules on shoulders. Itchiness; a kind of dry itch. Copyright © Médi-T ® 2000 Main.
Skin pale ; icteric. Itching nodules on shoulders. Considerable itchiness ; a kind of dry itch.

urinary.text: No stool nor passage of urine for twelve hours. Urine scanty and bloody.

female.text: (In sick :) Profuse catamenia with violent pains ; induced three successive times by bathing frosted feet in the solution.

respiratory.text: VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Cupr. s.]. Voice husky or veiled. Rapid sobbing respiration ; breathing short and labored. Respirations anxious and frequent ; 48-50 per minute. Anxious and interrupted breathing. Hacking cough impeding respiration. Croupy cough with very tenacious mucus.

back.text: Uneasiness between shoulders. Collection of wind pressing against back ; stiffness and pain on moving.

extremities.text: Dull aching soreness in middle of tibia, when walking ; > at rest ; tenderness on pressure. Formication in legs. Great coldness of feet. Extremities cold, nails cyanotic.

modalities.text: REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Cupr. s.]. Rest : > pain in tibia. Desire to be quiet : with headache. Stooping : as if top of head would come off. After rising from bed : pain as of tight band around head ; as if top of head would come off. Inspiration : tearing pain in hypochondria. Laughing : as if top of head would come off. Moving : pain in back. Walking : dull aching pain in tibia. Morning : headache ; burning in mouth and œsophagus. After 5 A. M., vomiting. At 5 P. M. : pains < with restlessness. Night : restlessness. Fire : sat near to > shivering. Cold wind : > head.

sleep.text: Drowsiness, frequently interrupted by abdominal pains.

fever_chill.text: Coldness beginning in small of back, going all over body, then suddenly going into legs, first left, then left, with shivering so that she sat near fire for a few minutes. Skin cold ; shivering. Internal, debilitating, exhausting heat. Flashes of heat, with burning of soles. Heat beginning on dorsa of feet, first left then right, then extending up anterior part of legs as far as knees ; lasted thirty minutes, then went off, leaving a sensation as if needles were pricking the parts for five minutes. Chilliness, shuddering, heat and sweat rapidly following each other. Cold sweat on forehead and extremities. Copious sweat, without thirst.
